aiuti_q.value: Which benefits can I find with DirittiOk?

aiuti_a.value: You can see, with their limits and links to official sources, the Assegno di Inclusione (ADI), the Assegno Unico (child benefit), the bonus sociali for electricity, gas, water and TARI (waste tax), the Carta Dedicata a te, the bonus nido (daycare bonus), the bonus nuovi nati (newborn bonus) and rent support. Each benefit has other requirements besides the ISEE: you can find the details on the [Rights and benefits](/diritti-pa) page.

dati_q.value: Do I need to sign up? Where is my data kept?

dati_a.value: No, you do not need to sign up. Your ISEE estimate, the money left to live on and the checklist stay only on this phone or computer. We do not track you. If you write to us using the contact form, we receive only the information you type.

anni_q.value: Which years count for the ISEE 2027?
anni_q.note: Domanda visibile in home e in /stima; deve coincidere con il JSON-LD FAQPage.

anni_a.value: Income from 2025, which means the income on your CU 2026 or 730/2026. Assets on 31 December 2025: bank accounts, investments, homes. Rent: the rent in your registered contract, up to 7,000 € a year. This is set by DPCM 159/2013 (Articles 4 and 5): the ISEE looks at the year two years before the DSU is submitted.

gratis_a.value: Yes, DirittiOk is free. We do not ask you to create an account and we do not track you. Your calculations stay on your device.

quale_q.note: Domanda visibile in /diritti-pa; deve coincidere con il JSON-LD FAQPage di quella pagina.

quale_a.value: Since 2026, INPS also calculates the ISEE for family and inclusion benefits (L. 199/2025). It is more favourable if you own your home or have at least 2 children. It is used only for ADI, Supporto per la formazione e il lavoro (training and work support), Assegno Unico, bonus nido and bonus nuovi nati. For everything else, the standard ISEE applies.

stima_lead1.value: This calculator guides you through 5 steps to estimate your ISEE 2027: the standard ISEE, the ISEE for family and inclusion benefits and, if useful for you, the current ISEE (ISEE corrente). You enter your household, your 2025 income, your fixed costs today and your assets on 31 December 2025. At the end you see an estimate of the indicator, how much you have left each month to live on and which public benefits you could look into, with a link to the source of each limit.

stima_lead2.value: The steps are free and you do not need to sign up. Your calculations stay only on this phone or computer: we do not send your estimate data to any server. Official values come only from the DSU (the ISEE declaration) submitted to INPS or a CAF (tax assistance centre). This is a rough estimate, based on the rules known in November 2026.

stima_lead3.value: The five steps cover: your household; your 2025 income and what comes in today; home and fixed costs; your assets; and any drop in income, for the current ISEE. Before you go to a CAF, you can also check the [checklist of documents for the DSU](/checklist-dsu) and the page on [bonuses and public benefits linked to the ISEE](/diritti-pa).

stima_foot.value: Your estimate data is saved only on this device while you type. Before you go to a CAF, you can see the [checklist of documents](/checklist-dsu) and the [bonuses and public benefits](/diritti-pa).

s1_intro.value: For the ISEE, your household is everyone on your family registration (stato di famiglia), plus your spouse and dependent children, even if they live elsewhere.

s1_componenti.value: How many people are in your household?

s1_figli.value: How many of them are children (of any age)?

s1_figli_help.value: This is needed for the extra points on the scale and for the allowances.

s1_under3.value: Of these, how many are under 3?

s1_over67.value: Of these, how many are 67 or older?

s1_disabili.value: How many have a certified medium or severe disability, or are certified as not self-sufficient?

s1_disabili_help.value: Each of these people adds 0.5 to the equivalence scale.

s1_genitoreSolo.value: Is there only one parent with children under 18?

s1_genitoriLavorano.value: In 2025, did both parents (or the only parent) work for at least 6 months?

err_figli.value: There must be fewer children than household members (there is at least one parent).

err_minori.value: This cannot be more than the number of household members.

err_under3.value: This cannot be more than the number of children under 18.

err_over60.value: Children under 18 plus people over 60 add up to more than the household members.

err_over67.value: This cannot be more than the number of people over 60.

err_disabili.value: This cannot be more than the number of household members.

err_number.value: Enter a number that is zero or more.

s2_intro.value: For the ISEE 2027, what counts is your 2025 income (the income on your CU 2026 or 730/2026). Add up the amounts for the whole household.

s2_redditoDip.value: Income from employment or similar in 2025

s2_redditoDip_help.value: The income shown on your CU (not the net pay on your payslip).

s2_nPens.value: How many people have a pension?

s2_redditoAltri.value: Other income in 2025 (self-employment, rent received, income with substitute tax)

s2_redditoAltri_help.value: If you have a flat-rate VAT number (partita IVA forfettaria), enter your taxable income.

s2_trattamentiEsenti.value: Tax-free benefits and allowances received in 2025 (not including Assegno Unico)

s2_trattamentiEsenti_help.value: Do not include benefits linked to disability: they do not count in the ISEE.

s2_mantenimentoVersato.value: Maintenance payments made in 2025 to a former spouse or for children

s2_nettoMensile.value: How much money comes into your household today, after tax, each month?

s2_nettoMensile_help.value: Wages, pensions and benefits you receive now: this is used to work out the money left to live on.

s3_intro.value: These costs are used to work out the money left to live on. In the ISEE, only rent with a registered contract counts.

s3_altro.value: Other (free use of a home, staying with others)

s3_contrattoRegistrato_help.value: Only the rent in a registered contract is taken off in the ISEE (up to 7,000 € a year).

s3_bollette.value: Bills (electricity, gas, water, internet), monthly average

s3_trasporti.value: Transport for work or school, per month

s3_prestiti.value: Loan or credit repayments, per month

s3_altreSpese.value: Other fixed costs (school meals, medical care, fees), per month

s4_intro.value: Enter the situation of the whole household on 31 December 2025.

s4_valoreCasa.value: IMU value of the home you live in

s4_valoreCasa_help.value: This is not the market price. If you do not know it, work it out below from the cadastral income (rendita catastale).

s4_rendita_summary.value: Work it out from the cadastral income

s4_rendita_label.value: Cadastral income (rendita catastale, from the visura catastale)

s4_rendita_help.value: For homes (category A, except A/10): income × 1.05 × 160.

s4_mutuoCasa.value: Mortgage still owed on the home on 31/12/2025

s4_capoluogoMetro.value: Is the home in the main city of a metropolitan area?

s4_capoluogoMetro_help.value: These are: {elenco}. In these cities, the home allowance for the ISEE for family benefits rises to 120,000 €.
s4_capoluogoMetro_help.note: {elenco} è la lista dei capoluoghi, nomi propri italiani: non tradurre i nomi delle città.

s4_altriImmobili.value: IMU value of other buildings or land

s4_mutuoAltri.value: Mortgage still owed on these other properties

s4_contiSaldo.value: Bank accounts and cards: balance on 31/12/2025 (total)

s4_contiGiacenza.value: Bank accounts and cards: average balance in 2025 (total)

s4_contiGiacenza_help.value: You can find it on your bank statement or ask your bank. The higher of the two, balance or average balance, is used.

h2_due.value: Money left to live on and the ISEE are two different things

p_due.value: Money left to live on is what you really have left each month. The ISEE instead looks at 2025 income and assets on 31/12/2025: bills, transport, loan repayments and insurance do **not** lower it.

h2_scelte.value: Allowed choices that make a difference

t1.value: **Register your rental contract** and keep the registration details to hand: only then is the rent taken off your income (up to 7,000 € a year, +500 € for each child after the second).

t2.value: **Enter the mortgage still owed on 31/12/2025** for each property: it is taken off the value of the home. Ask your bank for a certificate of the remaining debt.

t3.value: **Home you own**: in the ISEE for family and inclusion benefits, the allowance is 91,500 € (120,000 € in the main cities of metropolitan areas), +2,500 € for each child living with you after the first. INPS calculates this automatically: you do not need to do anything.

t4.value: **Government bonds, postal savings bonds and postal savings books** are left out up to 50,000 € in total for the household (DPCM 13/2025). Declare them anyway: the calculation applies the exclusion.

t5.value: **Bank accounts**: the higher amount counts, either the balance on 31/12 or the yearly average balance. Check both carefully on your bank statement.

t6.value: **Disability**: declare any certified medium or severe disability or non-self-sufficiency. Each person adds 0.5 to the scale, and tax-free benefits linked to disability do not count as income.

t7.value: **Use the pre-filled DSU** on the INPS website: it reduces mistakes and mismatches that can block benefits.

h2_corrente.value: When the current ISEE is worth it

c1.value: You lost a permanent job or your hours were cut, your fixed-term contract ended (at least 120 days in the last 12 months) or you closed your self-employed business.

c2.value: A public benefit stopped (for example NASpI, unemployment benefit).

c3.value: Your income indicator dropped by more than 25% compared with the one in your standard ISEE.

c_note.value: First you need a valid standard ISEE. If you update only your income, the current ISEE lasts 6 months. From 1 April you can also update your assets, if they changed by more than 20%.

n1.value: Do not leave out household members, accounts, investments or properties: the data is cross-checked with the Agenzia delle Entrate (tax agency) and INPS.

n2.value: Do not move your official residence on paper only, to split the household.

n3.value: Do not put assets in other people's names or hide them: you would lose the benefits, a false DSU is a criminal offence and you must pay back what you received.

n_note.value: For special cases (separation, children not living with you, inheritance, businesses), go to a CAF or a patronato (free advice office for workers and families).

see_also.value: See also the [public benefits linked to the ISEE](/diritti-pa), the [checklist of documents](/checklist-dsu) and the [sources used](/fonti).

intro.value: Each benefit has other requirements (residence, citizenship, age, assets). Open the official source before you apply. How we check the values is explained in [Sources and rules used](/fonti) and in [Method and sources](/metodo).

h2_auu.value: Which ISEE you need for the Assegno Unico
h2_auu.note: H2 richiesto; la FAQ visibile deve usare lo stesso testo della domanda faq.quale_q oppure questa sezione deve contenere la risposta.

p_auu1.value: For the Assegno Unico, the **ISEE for family and inclusion benefits** is used, not the standard ISEE. It is the indicator set by L. 199/2025 and it is usually more favourable if you own your home or have at least two children. Without the Assegno Unico already received, it is also used for the bonus nido and the bonus nuovi nati.

p_auu2.value: Since 2026, INPS calculates this ISEE automatically. It is used only for ADI, Supporto per la formazione e il lavoro, Assegno Unico, bonus nido and bonus nuovi nati. For everything else (bonus sociali, Carta «Dedicata a te», many local council services), the standard ISEE applies.

p_manovra.value: The 2027 budget bill (A.C. 3174) is being examined by Parliament and **is not law yet**. Some measures and limits linked to the ISEE could change: we will check them again when the text becomes law.

manovra_fonte.value: [Official source: A.C. 3174 page on the Senate website](https://www.senato.it/leggi-e-documenti/disegni-di-legge/scheda-ddl?did=60577).

p1.value: DirittiOk (DirittiChiari 2027) is a service by **Pi.Gi Service**. It gives a rough estimate of your ISEE, of how much you have left to live on and of public benefits, so you can understand them calmly before you go to a CAF or the INPS website.

p_come1.value: The calculations follow the rules of DPCM 159/2013 and later updates, including law 199/2025 on the ISEE for family and inclusion benefits. The limits and figures come from official sources: INPS, ARERA, Ministero del Lavoro (Ministry of Labour), Ministero dell'Economia e delle Finanze (Ministry of Economy and Finance), Normattiva.

p_come2.value: Every value used in the calculator has a status: verified, 2026 value to be confirmed for 2027, or to be confirmed. The full list, with a link to each source, is on the [Sources and rules used](/fonti) page.

p_non.value: It is not a DSU and it does not replace the official INPS certificate, a CAF or professional advice. Your calculations stay only on your device. When a law is still being discussed in Parliament, we say so on the page and check it again when it becomes law.

p_chi.value: Author of the service: **Pi.Gi Service**. If you have a question: [contact form](/contatti) or [info@pigiservice.com](mailto:info@pigiservice.com).

p_titolare.value: DirittiOk (DirittiChiari 2027) is a service by **Pi.Gi Service di Gheoca Paula** (data controller). For any question: [info@pigiservice.com](mailto:info@pigiservice.com).
p_titolare.note: Il nome del titolare e «Pi.Gi Service di Gheoca Paula» non si traducono.

h2_local.value: Your calculations stay on your device

p_local.value: The ISEE estimate, the money left to live on, the benefits and the checklist are calculated and saved only on this phone or computer, locally. We do not send them to any server, we do not ask you to sign up, we do not track you and we do not use artificial intelligence.

p_delete.value: You can delete everything at any time with «Delete my data», at the bottom of the page.

p_form.value: If you write to us using the [contact form](/contatti), we receive only what you type: your name, email, phone or business (if you add them), your message, your consent and the page you are writing from. We use this data only to reply to you. It never includes any data from your ISEE estimate or the guided steps.

p_retention.value: Your message goes to [info@pigiservice.com](mailto:info@pigiservice.com). We keep it for as long as we need to reply to you and to meet any legal obligations.
